request.systemPrompt:
You are a software architect producing a design specification for a change to a
URL shortener service, based on a normalized requirement and an impact analysis.

Propose a specific technical approach. Name at least one alternative you
considered and rejected, and say why you rejected it: a design with no
considered alternative is not defensible.

Respond with exactly one fenced json block containing an object with these keys:
- classStructure: array of strings, one per class/component to add or change,
  each naming the class and its responsibility
- apiContract: string, an OpenAPI-fragment-style description of any new or
  changed endpoints (path, method, request/response shape)
- dataModelChanges: array of strings, schema or entity changes required
- chosenApproach: string, the approach you are recommending
- rejectedAlternatives: array of objects, each with "alternative" (string) and
  "reason" (string) for why it was not chosen
- affectsCriteria: array of strings, the acceptance criterion ids (like "AC-1")
  this design decision affects
request.userPrompt:
Produce a design specification for the change described below.

Requirement: Add a read-only GET endpoint that resolves a short code to its target URL, fetches the target page to extract the HTML title and meta description, and returns them as JSON. The fetch is subject to SSRF protection, a 3-second timeout, a 1 MB body cap, no redirect-following, and an in-process 1-hour cache keyed by short code. Fetch failures, timeouts, SSRF blocks, and redirect responses all yield HTTP 200 with null title/description. Non-existent short codes yield HTTP 404.

Impact analysis: # Impact analysis

**Nature of change:** greenfield

**Blast radius:** Moderately contained. The new endpoint is additive and read-only, so no existing write paths or redirect paths are touched. UrlApiController gains one new method; UrlService may be read for its findByShortCode logic but is not otherwise mutated. The SSRF guard and HTTP client are new infrastructure confined to the preview service layer. The only cross-cutting risk is classpath changes (e.g., adding an HTML-parsing library such as jsoup and a cache library or Caffeine) which affect the build file and could influence startup time.

## Files sent for review

- docker-compose.yml
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/UrlShortenerApplication.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/config/ClockConfig.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/controller/RedirectController.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/controller/UrlApiController.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/domain/CreateUrlRequest.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/domain/ShortCodeEncoder.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/domain/Url.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/domain/UrlResponse.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/exception/UrlExpiredException.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/exception/UrlNotFoundException.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/filter/CorrelationIdFilter.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/repository/UrlRepository.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/service/ClickRecorder.java

## Affected files

- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/controller/UrlApiController.java
- src/main/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/service/UrlService.java
- src/main/resources/application.yml
- src/test/java/com/schwab/urlshortener/controller/UrlApiControllerTest.java

## Regression risks

- Adding a new @GetMapping on /api/urls/{shortCode}/preview to UrlApiController could shadow or conflict with the existing @GetMapping("/{shortCode}") on UrlApiController if path variable patterns overlap — must verify Spring disambiguates /api/urls/{shortCode} vs /api/urls/{shortCode}/preview correctly
- Any new dependency added to build.gradle.kts (jsoup, Caffeine, etc.) could introduce version conflicts with existing Spring Boot managed dependencies
- If PreviewConfig registers a custom HttpClient or thread pool bean, it must not collide with any existing beans (currently none visible, but worth verifying)
- UrlApiControllerTest already tests GET /api/urls/{shortCode}; adding the new endpoint to the same controller means the test slice must be updated and could inadvertently break existing test setup if MockMvc configuration changes
- GlobalExceptionHandler already maps UrlNotFoundException to 404, so the preview endpoint inherits that mapping correctly — but any new exception type thrown by the preview service (e.g., a hypothetical SsrfException) must be swallowed inside UrlPreviewService before reaching the handler to satisfy the requirement that SSRF blocks yield 200, not an error response
